sentences.en: As the wars in Ukraine and the Middle East deepen, the U.S., under President Joe Biden, has taken a leading role in both.
sentences.zh: 随着乌克兰和中东战争的加剧，在乔·拜登总统的领导下，美国在这两场冲突中都发挥了主导作用。

sentences.en: But now the presidential campaign is raising a new and consequential question.
sentences.zh: 但现在，总统竞选提出了一个全新的、至关重要的问题。

sentences.en: Whose foreign policy will the world get next?
sentences.zh: 世界接下来将迎来谁的外交政策？

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Peter Baker explains.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事彼得·贝克来为我们解读。

sentences.en: It's Monday, September 30th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月30日，星期一。

sentences.en: So Peter, we're just weeks away from election day and the United States is deeply involved in protracted wars in Ukraine and the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 那么，彼得，距离选举日只有几周时间了，而美国深深卷入了乌克兰和中东旷日持久的战争中。

sentences.en: These will be issues for whoever is the next president.
sentences.zh: 无论谁成为下一任总统，这些都将是他们必须面对的问题。

sentences.en: So we wanted to talk to you about how the two candidates might approach these conflicts in foreign policy more broadly.
sentences.zh: 所以我们想和你聊聊，两位候选人可能会如何处理这些冲突以及更广泛的外交政策。

sentences.en: Just this weekend, we saw the killing of Hassan Nasrallah, the leader of the Lebanese militia group Hezbollah, by Israel.
sentences.zh: 就在这个周末，我们看到以色列杀死了黎巴嫩民兵组织真主党的领导人哈桑·纳斯鲁拉。

sentences.en: And I really want you first to start with just what the stakes are here.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想请你先谈谈这其中的利害关系是什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't think the stakes could be higher for the Middle East to erupt into a wider war, which is the fear in Washington right now in the thick of a presidential campaign,
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为中东爆发全面战争的风险再怎么高估也不为过，这也是目前正处于总统竞選白热化阶段的华盛顿所担忧的，

sentences.en: just reminds us of how important America still is in the world, right?
sentences.zh: 这正好提醒了我们美国在世界上依然有多么重要，对吧？

sentences.en: That we are not, in fact, behind an ocean where we cannot care about what happens across the globe.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们并不是躲在大洋后面，就可以对全球发生的事情漠不关心。

sentences.en: But where it's going to go at this point in the Middle East, we don't know.
sentences.zh: 但在中东，局势接下来会走向何方，我们还不得而知。

sentences.en: The fear is that the killing of Nasrallah, who was mourned by nobody in the United States, who has blood on his hands after decades of leading a terrorist organization,
sentences.zh: 大家担心的是，杀死纳斯鲁拉——在美国没有人会为他哀悼，他在领导一个恐怖组织几十年后双手沾满鲜血——

sentences.en: but his killing could inflame the region in a way that President Biden has been trying to avoid for almost 12 months now.
sentences.zh: 但杀死他可能会以一种拜登总统近12个月来一直极力避免的方式点燃整个地区。

sentences.en: And the idea of a wider, more expansive war in the Middle East, one that not only escalates with Hezbollah itself, but possibly brings in its patron, Iran,
sentences.zh: 而一场更大规模、更广泛的中东战争，不仅会与真主党本身升级，还可能把它的支持者伊朗卷入其中，

sentences.en: that is a huge challenge.
sentences.zh: 那将是一个巨大的挑战。

sentences.en: And therefore, of course, it's extremely important to know who's going to take over in just a few weeks.
sentences.zh: 因此，当然，弄清楚几周后谁将接手权力至关重要。

sentences.en: And the difference between these two candidates in their outlook, in their vision, in their approach to the world could hardly be bigger.
sentences.zh: 这两位候选人在世界观、愿景以及处理世界事务的方法上的差异，可以说是再大不过了。

sentences.en: So let's go to the candidates themselves.
sentences.zh: 那我们来谈谈候选人本身吧。

sentences.en: Tell me how you see Donald Trump and Kamala Harris in terms of how they would steer America in the world, like high level.
sentences.zh: 请告诉我，在你看来，唐纳德·特朗普和卡玛拉·哈里斯将如何从宏观层面上引领美国走向世界？

sentences.en: Well, Kamala Harris, of course, hasn't had a lot of experience in foreign policy, but she's learned a lot at the side of President Biden as his vice president.
sentences.zh: 嗯，卡玛拉·哈里斯在外交政策方面的经验当然不多，但作为副总统，她在拜登总统身边学到了很多。

sentences.en: So we're sort of guessing a little bit about her vision and her views.
sentences.zh: 所以我们对她的愿景和观点有点像是在猜测。

sentences.en: I think our general assumption is that she's pretty close to where Biden is.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们普遍的假设是，她和拜登的立场相当接近。

sentences.en: And I think it's safe to assume that she is basically a pretty conventional center-left democratic foreign policy thinker.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为可以安全地推断，她基本上是一个相当正统的中左翼民主党外交政策思想家。

sentences.en: I mean, to the extent that she brings her own individual perspective, it probably comes from her time as a prosecutor and a lawyer,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就她带有个人的视角而言，这大概源于她担任检察官和律师的经历，

sentences.en: that she believes in the international rules-based order.
sentences.zh: 她坚信基于规则的国际秩序。

sentences.en: So she looks at foreign policy in the sense of who is following the rules, in effect, in terms of whether it be trade, security, or economics.
sentences.zh: 因此，她在看待外交政策时，无论是贸易、安全还是经济，实际上都是看谁在遵守规则。

sentences.en: And Peter, tell me about Trump.
sentences.zh: 彼得，那我们谈谈特朗普吧。

sentences.en: How would you describe him high level?
sentences.zh: 你会如何从宏观层面来描述他？

sentences.en: Well, high level, he is the opposite, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，从宏观层面来看，他恰恰相反，对吧？

sentences.en: He is a disruptive force when it comes to international affairs, proudly so.
sentences.zh: 在国际事务上，他是一个具有颠覆性的力量，而且他对此引以为傲。

sentences.en: If there's anything he believes, it's this idea that other countries are shafting the United States, often our own friends, our friends in Europe, our friends in Asia,
sentences.zh: 如果说他有什么坚定的信念，那就是他认为其他国家一直在占美国的便宜，这里通常指我们的朋友，我们在欧洲的朋友，我们在亚洲的朋友，

sentences.en: that they are getting one over on the United States when it comes to trade and economics, when it comes to security arrangements and so on.
sentences.zh: 在贸易、经济、安全安排等方面，他们一直在占美国的便宜。

sentences.en: And so he's often been much harder on America's allies than he has been on America's adversaries.
sentences.zh: 因此，他对美国盟友的态度往往比对美国对手的态度还要严厉得多。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's drawn to these strongmen in a way, and it's a real break with what came before when it comes to the Republican Party and really just Washington consensus generally.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，他被这些强人所吸引，这与共和党过去的做法，以及华盛顿以往的普遍共识形成了真正的決裂。

sentences.en: So on the face of it, Peter, these are two very different candidates.
sentences.zh: 所以表面上看，彼得，这是两位截然不同的候选人。

sentences.en: Let's talk about how they would actually be on the issues, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，让我们来聊聊他们在具体议题上会怎么做。

sentences.en: Maybe let's start with this killing of Hassan Nasrallah, which plunges us directly into the unknown when it comes to Israel and Iran,
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以从杀死哈桑·纳斯鲁拉开始，这把我们直接带入了关于以色列和伊朗的未知领域，

sentences.en: which is, of course, the big backer and power behind Hezbollah.
sentences.zh: 而伊朗当然是真主党背后的大金主和力量源泉。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So over the last few days, what we've seen is Israel escalating the war in Lebanon in a major way after a year of trading cross-border fire.
sentences.zh: 所以在过去几天里，我们看到以色列在经历了长达一年的跨境交火后，大幅升级了在黎巴嫩的战争。

sentences.en: And on Friday, Israel struck a densely packed neighborhood just south of Beirut, killing Hassan Nasrallah, the head of Hezbollah.
sentences.zh: 周五，以色列空袭了贝鲁特南部一个极其拥挤的街区，炸死了真主党领导人哈桑·纳斯鲁拉。

sentences.en: And he, of course, has been such a remarkably powerful and dangerous force in the Middle East now for decades.
sentences.zh: 当然，几十年来，他一直是中东一股非常强大且危险的力量。

sentences.en: It was such a shock, right, Peter?
sentences.zh: 这太令人震惊了，对吧，彼得？

sentences.en: Like, this guy was a fixture, and now suddenly he's gone.
sentences.zh: 就好比，这家伙是个老面孔了，现在突然就没了。

sentences.en: It just felt like I didn't even know what world we were living in.
sentences.zh: 感觉我都不知道我们生活在怎样的一个世界里了。

sentences.en: It's a paradigm-changing moment, right?
sentences.zh: 这是一个范式转变的时刻，对吧？

sentences.en: And at the same time, Israel has continued to strike Hezbollah targets around Lebanon, and it's causing, you know, deep chaos within the country.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，以色列继续打击黎巴嫩各地的真主党目标，你知道的，这正在该国内部引发深深的混乱。

sentences.en: According to the government there, as many as a million people could be displaced.
sentences.zh: 据当地政府称，多达一百万人可能流离失所。

sentences.en: And so far, more than a thousand have been killed since this ramped-up offensive began, including civilians, women and children.
sentences.zh: 自这次加剧的攻势开始以来，已有超过一千人丧生，其中包括平民、妇女和儿童。

sentences.en: And now all eyes are really on Iran and whether they will, in effect, enter the war in a much bigger way than they already have.
sentences.zh: 现在所有人的目光都真正聚焦在伊朗身上，看他们是否会以比以往大得多的规模真正卷入这场战争。

sentences.en: They've been fighting Israel really for years through these proxy groups, a kind of shadow war.
sentences.zh: 多年来，他们其实一直通过这些代理人集团与以色列作战，这是一场某种意义上的影子战争。

sentences.en: But now the fear is it could be an actual all-out regional war, and that might bring in the United States, too.
sentences.zh: 但现在的担忧是，这可能变成一场彻头彻尾的全面地区战争，而这也可能把美国拖下水。

sentences.en: What has Washington said about this?
sentences.zh: 华盛顿对此有何表态？

sentences.en: So Biden and Harris both released statements pretty similar to each other, saying that this was a measure of justice for the victims of Hezbollah.
sentences.zh: 所以拜登和哈里斯都发表了彼此非常相似的声明，称这是为真主党的受害者伸张正义的一项举措。

sentences.en: At the same time, they also talked about the need for diplomacy, to de-escalate the conflict.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他们也谈到了进行外交斡旋、缓和冲突的必要性。

sentences.en: They're called on the parties, the combatants, to agree to these ceasefire proposals that are out there to end the fighting, at least temporarily.
sentences.zh: 他们呼吁各方、交战各方同意现有的停火提议，至少暂时结束战斗。

sentences.en: Now, on the Republican side, the Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson, and his leadership team put out their own statement praising, of course, Israel's killing of Nasrallah,
sentences.zh: 至于共和党方面，众议院议长迈克·约翰逊和他的领导团队发表了自己的声明，一方面赞扬以色列炸死了纳斯鲁拉，

sentences.en: but also attacking the Biden administration for not doing enough, in their view, to support Israel.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面也抨击拜登政府在他们看来做得不够，未能充分支持以色列。

sentences.en: The one person we haven't heard from, ironically, is Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，我们唯独没有听到一个人发声，那就是唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: He had a whole long rally yesterday and said not one word about Hezbollah and the killing of Nasrallah and gave no clue, therefore, into his thinking about what this means
sentences.zh: 他昨天举行了一场漫长的集会，对真主党和杀死纳斯鲁拉的事只字未提，因此也没有透露任何关于他如何看待这件事的线索，

sentences.en: and what the United States should be doing at this point.
sentences.zh: 以及美国在此时此刻应该做些什么。

sentences.en: And we know, of course, about Trump that he does have an antagonistic relationship with the Iranians.
sentences.zh: 当然我们都知道，特朗普与伊朗人确实存在敌对关系。

sentences.en: He pulled out of the Iran nuclear agreement, which was brokered under President Obama, and put sanctions back on Tehran.
sentences.zh: 他退出了在奥巴马总统任内促成的伊朗核协议，并重新对德黑兰实施了制裁。

sentences.en: And when we're looking at the candidates here, how do each see Iran?
sentences.zh: 当我们审视这里的候选人时，他们各自是如何看待伊朗的？

sentences.en: Well, definitely Trump sees Iran as the main malign force, not only in the Middle East, but one of the main enemies around the world, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，毫无疑问，特朗普将伊朗视为主要的邪恶力量，不仅在中东如此，也是世界各地的主要敌人之一，对吧？

sentences.en: He's willing to say nice things about Vladimir Putin and Kim Jong-un in North Korea.
sentences.zh: 他愿意对俄罗斯的弗拉基米尔·普京和朝鲜的金正恩说好话。

sentences.en: Not one good word, obviously, for Iran.
sentences.zh: 显然，对伊朗则一句好话也没有。

sentences.en: I think Harris obviously sees Iran as a malign force as well, but she has been part of an administration that was willing to at least try to restart negotiations
sentences.zh: 我想哈里斯显然也将伊朗视为一股邪恶力量，但她所在的政府此前至少愿意尝试重新开启关于其核项目的谈判。

sentences.en: over their nuclear program.
sentences.zh: 关于他们的核项目。

sentences.en: Now, that didn't go anywhere.
sentences.zh: 然而，那并没有什么进展。

sentences.en: That ended up fizzling.
sentences.zh: 最后不了了之了。

sentences.en: And right now, we are at odds with Iran.
sentences.zh: 而现在，我们与伊朗处于对立状态。

sentences.en: We have sanctioned Iran.
sentences.zh: 我们制裁了伊朗。

sentences.en: We are not part of an agreement with Iran.
sentences.zh: 我们不是伊朗协议的参与方。

sentences.en: And it doesn't look like one is happening anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 而且短期内似乎也不会达成这样的协议。

sentences.en: So where Harris wants to take the policy with Iran right now is a little unclear.
sentences.zh: 因此，哈里斯现在想把对伊朗的政策带向何方，目前还不太明朗。

sentences.en: She obviously will talk about being tough on Iran, but she is not trying to raise the temperature and use the same kind of language that former President Trump does.
sentences.zh: 她显然会谈到对伊朗采取强硬态度，但她并不想升温局势，也不打算使用前总统特朗普那种言论。

sentences.en: So, Peter, let's go to Israel, which is, of course, at the center of all of this, and Israel's relationship with the United States,
sentences.zh: 所以，彼得，让我们转向以色列，它当然是这一切的核心，以及以色列与美国的关系，

sentences.en: which is under a lot of strain right now as it wages its war against Hamas in Gaza almost a year after Hamas attacked on October 7th.
sentences.zh: 在哈马斯10月7日发动袭击近一年后，随着以色列在加沙对哈马斯发动战争，美以关系目前承受着巨大的压力。

sentences.en: This conflict is top of mind, I think, for a lot of voters.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这场冲突是许多选民首要关心的问题。

sentences.en: And I'm curious how the candidates are talking about it.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇候选人们是怎么谈论它的。

sentences.en: Maybe start with Trump.
sentences.zh: 也许可以从特朗普开始。

sentences.en: Well, one way it comes up on the campaign trail for Trump is the way he tries to persuade Jewish American voters to support him.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对特朗普来说，这在竞选活动中出现的一个方式是他试图说服美国犹太选民支持他。

sentences.en: He likes to boast of being Israel's great friend during his first term, but so much so he's taken it to the point of saying that if you're Jewish
sentences.zh: 他喜欢吹嘘自己在第一任期内是以色列的伟大朋友，甚至到了这种地步：他说如果你是犹太人，

sentences.en: and you vote against him, you somehow are betraying Israel or betraying Judaism, which, by the way, is a concept that's very offensive to a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 而你投票反对他，你就是在某种程度上背叛了以色列或背叛了犹太教，顺便说一句，这个观点对许多人来说是非常冒犯的。

sentences.en: But that's where he is framing it right now.
sentences.zh: 但这就是他目前对该问题的定性。

sentences.en: Now, it's fair to say there's probably never been a president who's been more willing to give Israeli leadership what it wanted than Donald Trump, right?
sentences.zh: 公平地说，可能从来没有哪位总统像唐纳德·特朗普那样，愿意如此顺从地满足以色列领导层的要求，对吧？

sentences.en: He moved the American embassy from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem, which is something that the previous presidents had all declined to do.
sentences.zh: 他将美国大使馆从特拉维夫搬到了耶路撒冷，这是前几任总统都拒绝做的事。

sentences.en: He recognized Israeli sovereignty over the Golan Heights, which, again, no president had done up until that point.
sentences.zh: 他承认了以色列对戈兰高地的主权，同样，在此之前没有哪位总统这么做过。

sentences.en: He closed the Palestinian office in Washington and cut off aid, and he wasn't even on speaking terms with Mahmoud Abbas, the president of the Palestinian Authority.
sentences.zh: 他关闭了巴勒斯坦驻华盛顿办事处并切断了援助，甚至与巴勒斯坦权力机构主席马哈茂德·阿巴斯连话都说不上。

sentences.en: So in Trump, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was getting an awful lot of what he wanted.
sentences.zh: 所以在特朗普这里，总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡得到了他想要的相当多的东西。

sentences.en: But when it comes to the war in Gaza itself, Trump has been relatively quiet.
sentences.zh: 但谈到加沙本身的战争时，特朗普一直相对低调。

sentences.en: He really hasn't given any kind of extended analysis or interview to explain how he sees the war in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 他真的没有发表任何长篇大论或接受深入采访来解释他如何看待加沙战争。

sentences.en: And in fact, if anything, when he has talked about it, he has said things that Israel supporters are uncomfortable with, like Israel needs to get this over with.
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果说他谈过的话，他也是在说一些让以色列支持者感到不安的话，比如以色列需要把这事了结。

sentences.en: He's getting decimated with this publicity.
sentences.zh: 他的公众形象正因此受到惨重打击。

sentences.en: There's too much killing.
sentences.zh: 杀戮太多了。

sentences.en: Not that he is expressing concern for those who are being killed, but because he says it's hurting Israel's reputation in the world.
sentences.zh: 倒不是说他在对那些被杀害的人表达关切，而是因为他说这正在损害以色列在世界上的声誉。

sentences.en: Israel has to handle their public relations.
sentences.zh: 以色列必须处理好他们的公关关系。

sentences.en: Their public relations are not good.
sentences.zh: 他们的公关关系做得很不好。

sentences.en: And so he needs to get it over with.
sentences.zh: 所以他需要把这事了结。

sentences.en: I think another thing we could say is he probably wouldn't be as committed to humanitarian aid for the Palestinians in Gaza as the Biden administration has been.
sentences.zh: 我想我们还可以说的另一件事是，他可能不会像拜登政府那样致力于向加沙的巴勒斯坦人提供人道主义援助。

sentences.en: I've never heard Trump express any interest in that.
sentences.zh: 我从来没听特朗普对那表现出任何兴趣。

sentences.en: And he doesn't particularly like wars.
sentences.zh: 而且他特别不喜欢战争。

sentences.en: I mean, I think that's one thing he has expressed pride about, not starting any wars while he was president.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为这是他引以为豪的一点，即他在担任总统期间没有挑起任何战争。

sentences.en: And I don't know that he feels very comfortable with an extended war in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他是否会对一场在中东持续的战争感到安心。

sentences.en: I don't know what he would be willing to do to stop it or how far he would be willing to go to pressure Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他愿意做什么来阻止它，或者他愿意走多远去向内塔尼亚胡施压。

sentences.en: But I don't think Netanyahu can count on 100% unvarnished support like he had in the first three years of Trump's presidency.
sentences.zh: 但我认为内塔尼亚胡不能指望能像特朗普总统任期的前三年那样，获得百分之百毫无保留的支持。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's interesting how, you know, Trump has this tough guy thing.
sentences.zh: 是的，很有意思，你知道的，特朗普有一种硬汉的人设。

sentences.en: But at the same time, you know, it's not actually militaristic.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，你知道，这实际上并不是军国主义式的。

sentences.en: Like he doesn't believe in kind of using American military might like traditional Republicans have.
sentences.zh: 就像他不像传统共和党人那样相信动用美国的军事力量。

sentences.en: And it's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: He didn't start a war, which is one of the things I always think about a Trump administration and how different it was from, say, the administration of George W.
sentences.zh: 他没有发动战争，这是我每次想到特朗普政府时总会想到的事情之一，它与比如说乔治·W·布什政府有多么不同，

sentences.en: Bush, which was kind of a more traditional political institutionalist guy, but did start this big war.
sentences.zh: 后者是一个更为传统的政治体制派人物，但确实发动了这场大战。

sentences.en: That's just not what Trump does.
sentences.zh: 那根本不是特朗普的行事风格。

sentences.en: Yeah, no, it's really true.
sentences.zh: 对，没错，确实如此。

sentences.en: He's the opposite of Teddy Roosevelt, right?
sentences.zh: 他跟西奥多·罗斯福恰恰相反，对吧？

sentences.en: Teddy Roosevelt was speak softly and carry a big stick.
sentences.zh: 西奥多·罗斯福主张“说话温和，手持大棒”。

sentences.en: Trump is speak loudly, but carry a small stick.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普则是“说话大声，手持小棒”。

sentences.en: So he is actually somebody who has not been eager to pull the trigger, even though he speaks very gruffly and threateningly.
sentences.zh: 所以他实际上是一个并不急于扣动扳机的人，尽管他说话非常粗鲁且具有威胁性。

sentences.en: Bellicosely.
sentences.zh: 好战地。

sentences.en: Bellicosely, right?
sentences.zh: 好战地，对吧？

sentences.en: Right, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: And Peter, what about Harris?
sentences.zh: 那么彼得，哈里斯呢？

sentences.en: What do we know about how she would distinguish herself from the Biden administration's approach to Israel?
sentences.zh: 关于她将如何使自己与拜登政府对待以色列的方法区别开来，我们知道些什么？

sentences.en: Kamala Harris is stuck close to President Biden's policy, but she sounds different, right, at times.
sentences.zh: 卡玛拉·哈里斯紧跟拜登总统的政策，但在有时，她的语气听起来确实不同，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, let's understand how we got here.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们先弄清楚我们是怎么走到这一步的。

sentences.en: When she describes the situation there, it's a matter of emphasis.
sentences.zh: 当她描述那里的局势时，这是一个侧重点的问题。

sentences.en: Her emphasis on the suffering of the Palestinians sounds much more determined than when Biden says that.
sentences.zh: 她对巴勒斯坦人苦难的强调，听起来比拜登表达时要坚定得多。

sentences.en: Then I say now, Israel has a right to defend itself.
sentences.zh: 然后我说现在，以色列有权捍卫自己。

sentences.en: We would.
sentences.zh: 我们会。

sentences.en: She will say that Israel has every right to defend itself.
sentences.zh: 她会说以色列完全有权捍卫自己。

sentences.en: She will condemn the October 7th terrorist attack by Hamas in strong terms, but...
sentences.zh: 她将以严厉的措辞谴责哈马斯对10月7日的恐怖袭击，但是……

sentences.en: Because it is also true, far too many innocent Palestinians have been killed.
sentences.zh: 因为这也是事实，有太多无辜的巴勒斯坦人丧生。

sentences.en: Children, mothers.
sentences.zh: 儿童，母亲。

sentences.en: When she speaks about it, you hear more empathy, it sounds like, to people for the suffering of the civilians, at least, in Gaza, who are paying a price.
sentences.zh: 当她谈到这一点时，你能听到更多的同情，听起来，至少是对加沙平民的苦难，那些正在付出代价的人。

sentences.en: But we must have a two-state solution where we can rebuild Gaza, where the Palestinians have security, self-determination, and the dignity they so rightly deserve.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须实现两国方案，让我们能够重建加沙，让巴勒斯坦人拥有安全、自决权以及他们理应得到的尊严。

sentences.en: And so people assume because of that that she will be tougher on Netanyahu than Biden has been, that she would have less patience for Netanyahu and put more pressure on him.
sentences.zh: 因此人们据此推测，她在对内塔尼亚胡的态度上会比拜登更强硬，对内塔尼亚胡会失去耐心并向他施加更多压力。

sentences.en: Okay, so let's turn to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 好的，那我们转向乌克兰。

sentences.en: What would a Harris administration look like on that front?
sentences.zh: 哈里斯政府在这方面会是怎样的面貌？

sentences.en: Well, I think the Harris administration would continue a lot of the policy that we've seen in the last two and a half years since Putin's full-scale invasion.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为哈里斯政府将延续自普京全面入侵以来我们在过去两年半中所看到的许多政策。

sentences.en: She is invested in that.
sentences.zh: 她对这一点投入很深。

sentences.en: I actually met with Zelensky a few days before Russia invaded.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我在俄罗斯入侵前几天会见了泽连斯基。

sentences.en: She's met with Zelensky now seven times, including the meeting they had together late last week.
sentences.zh: 她现在已经与泽连斯基会面了七次，包括上周晚些时候他们的会晤。

sentences.en: And so whatever she might have thought about it coming in, she's very much a part of the Biden policy and is unlikely to make large-scale shifts.
sentences.zh: 所以无论她刚上任时对此有何看法，她都深度参与了拜登的政策，不大可能做出大规模的转变。

sentences.en: We brought 50 countries together to support Ukraine in its righteous defense.
sentences.zh: 我们召集了50个国家支持乌克兰进行正义的防卫。

sentences.en: She believes that Russia cannot be allowed to simply win because if Russia wins, it means that the whole international rules-based order is out the window.
sentences.zh: 她认为绝不能让俄罗斯轻易获胜，因为如果俄罗斯获胜，就意味着整个基于规则的国际秩序将荡然无存。

sentences.en: Because Putin's agenda is not just about Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 因为普京的议程不仅仅是针对乌克兰。

sentences.en: It means that a larger country can use force to rewrite the map without any regard to the rules, without any regard to sovereignty and independence.
sentences.zh: 这意味着一个较大的国家可以使用武力重写地图，而完全不顾规则，完全不顾主权和独立。

sentences.en: And in fact, she took a dig at Trump when she met with Zelensky, calling what he is suggesting a proposal for surrender.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她在会见泽连斯基时对特朗普进行了挖苦，称他提出的建议是一份投降提议。

sentences.en: So very much continuing the Biden doctrine here on Ukraine, American leadership, convening allies, NATO.
sentences.zh: 所以在乌克兰问题上非常延续了拜登的路线，即美国领导力、召集盟友、北约。

sentences.en: And she does this dig at Trump.
sentences.zh: 而且她对特朗普进行了这番挖苦。

sentences.en: Bring us to Trump.
sentences.zh: 让我们谈谈特朗普。

sentences.en: How would he be different?
sentences.zh: 他会有什么不同？

sentences.en: I think he'd be vastly different.
sentences.zh: 我认为他会有巨大的不同。

sentences.en: It's very hard to see any foreign policy issue that would be more 180-degree flip.
sentences.zh: 很难找到比这更来个180度大转弯的外交政策议题了。

sentences.en: I will have that war settled in one day, 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 我会在一天、24小时内解决这场战争。

sentences.en: He has said that he would end the war in 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 他曾表示他会在24小时内结束战争。

sentences.en: Now, how he would do that, he doesn't exactly say.
sentences.zh: 至于他将如何做到这一点，他并没有明确说明。

sentences.en: You can break that deal.
sentences.zh: 你可以打破那项协议。

sentences.en: A hundred percent, it would be easy.
sentences.zh: 百分之百，这会很轻松。

sentences.en: That deal would be easy.
sentences.zh: 那项协议会很轻松。

sentences.en: Not a single person I know who knows anything about Russia and Ukraine thinks is possible.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，每一个了解俄罗斯和乌克兰的人，没有一个认为这是可能的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: A, it's not realistic, and B, it's just a complete and utter reversal of where the United States has traditionally stood,
sentences.zh: 第一，这不切实际；第二，这完全且彻底颠覆了美国一贯的立场，

sentences.en: which is that you don't reward aggression, that you don't give in to international bullies.
sentences.zh: 即你不能奖励侵略，你不能向国际恶霸屈服。

sentences.en: Trump has spent so much time expressing admiration of Putin that people still wonder why they're so close.
sentences.zh: 特朗普花了大量时间表达对普京的钦佩，以至于人们仍然纳闷他们为什么会这么亲密。

sentences.en: What is it about Putin that makes Trump so flattering?
sentences.zh: 普京身上有什么特质让特朗普如此奉承？

sentences.en: He's not expressed any condemnation of the Russian war.
sentences.zh: 他没有对俄罗斯的战争表达任何谴责。

sentences.en: I want to ask you a very simple question tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚我想问你一个非常简单的问题。

sentences.en: Do you want Ukraine to win this war?
sentences.zh: 你希望乌克兰赢得这场战争吗？

sentences.en: And when he's asked, as he was at the debate, whether he wants Ukraine to win...
sentences.zh: 当被问及他是否希望乌克兰获胜时，正如他在辩论中所被问到的那样……

sentences.en: I want the war to stop.
sentences.zh: 我希望战争停止。

sentences.en: I want to save lives.
sentences.zh: 我想拯救生命。

sentences.en: He always ducks the question.
sentences.zh: 他总是回避这个问题。

sentences.en: I don't think in terms of winning and losing.
sentences.zh: 我不会从输赢的角度去思考。

sentences.en: I think in terms of...
sentences.zh: 我是从……的角度来思考的。

sentences.en: So even last week, while Zelensky was visiting for the United Nations General Assembly, he had a last-minute meeting with Trump in New York.
sentences.zh: 所以就在上周，当泽连斯基为出席联合国大会而访问期间，他在纽约与特朗普进行了一次最后一刻的会面。

sentences.en: And there again, Trump refused to condemn Russia for the war.
sentences.zh: 在那里，特朗普再次拒绝就这场战争谴责俄罗斯。

sentences.en: Instead, he suggested that Putin wants the war to end and refused to give any assurances to Zelensky for American support.
sentences.zh: 相反，他暗示普京希望战争结束，并拒绝向泽连斯基提供任何美国支持的保证。

sentences.en: But I guess the flip side of it is still kind of confusing to me, Peter.
sentences.zh: 但我猜事情的另一面对我来说仍然有点让人困惑，彼得。

sentences.en: Like, why do you think it is that Trump is like that on Ukraine?
sentences.zh: 比如，你认为为什么特朗普在乌克兰问题上会是这样？

sentences.en: Like, why is he so opposed to their war against Russia?
sentences.zh: 比如，为什么他如此反对他们对俄罗斯的战争？

sentences.en: Which, you know, was obviously supported by old-school Republicans quite strongly.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这场战争显然得到了老派共和党人的强烈支持。

sentences.en: It's America first, right?
sentences.zh: 这就是美国优先，对吧？

sentences.en: That's his theory of international relations.
sentences.zh: 那是他的国际关系理论。

sentences.en: Unless he sees it as an immediate American benefit, he doesn't want to have anything to do with it.
sentences.zh: 除非他认为这能带来直接的美国利益，否则他根本不想沾边。

sentences.en: A lot of people would argue, of course, it is in America's interest to stop countries from invading each other.
sentences.zh: 当然，很多人会辩称，阻止各国互相入侵符合美国的利益。

sentences.en: But he doesn't see it that way.
sentences.zh: 但他不这么看。

sentences.en: In his telling of it, we have no business being involved unless we get something out of it.
sentences.zh: 在他的叙述中，除非我们从中得到什么好处，否则我们没有理由插手。

sentences.en: Okay, so Peter, say Trump wins, it's a Trump administration, what does his approach to Ukraine actually look like in practice?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么彼得，假设特朗普获胜，是一个特朗普政府，他在实践中对乌克兰的方法到底是什么样的？

sentences.en: And what would be the effect of it?
sentences.zh: 其影响会是什么？

sentences.en: Well, first off, of course, there will probably not be any more American arms and American aid.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，当然，可能不会再有美国的武器和美国的援助了。

sentences.en: At least Ukraine shouldn't count on that.
sentences.zh: 至少乌克兰不应该指望这一点。

sentences.en: And I think that that by itself would be a dramatic change on the ground there.
sentences.zh: 我认为单凭这一点就会对当地局势造成戏剧性的改变。

sentences.en: American arms have been critical in helping Ukraine beat back a much stronger, much bigger opponent, invader.
sentences.zh: 美国武器在帮助乌克兰击退一个强大得多、庞大得多的对手、侵略者方面至关重要。

sentences.en: Now, in theory, Europe could fill the void, but there's weariness about the war in Europe as well.
sentences.zh: 理论上，欧洲可以填补这个空白，但欧洲对这场战争也感到了疲惫。

sentences.en: And it would be very challenging for European leaders to come up with even more money to fill the gap if the United States withdraws.
sentences.zh: 如果美国撤出，欧洲领导人要筹集更多的资金来填补这个缺口将是非常具有挑战性的。

sentences.en: And I assume if there's a Harris administration, she's also not necessarily going to have an easy time getting a lot more money for Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我假设如果是哈里斯政府，她要为乌克兰争取更多资金也未必是一件容易的事。

sentences.en: What about what she would actually do?
sentences.zh: 关于她实际上会做什么呢？

sentences.en: Would it be different than what Biden has done?
sentences.zh: 会和拜登做过的不一样吗？

sentences.en: I think it would probably be roughly the same, but she will be presented with a different set of circumstances than he was, right?
sentences.zh: 我认为可能大致相同，但她将面临与他不同的一套环境，对吧？

sentences.en: Biden was presented with the initial invasion.
sentences.zh: 拜登面对的是最初的入侵。

sentences.en: She will be coming at it later in the progress of the war when there'll be more pressure to find a resolution, to get to some sort of a halt in the killing.
sentences.zh: 她将在战争进行到更晚的阶段介入，届时将有更大的压力去寻找解决方案，让杀戮以某种方式停下来。

sentences.en: I think it's fair to assume she wouldn't make concessions that Ukraine doesn't agree to.
sentences.zh: 我认为可以公平推测，她不会做出乌克兰不同意的让步。

sentences.en: She would take her cues, presumably from Zelensky or the Ukrainian leadership.
sentences.zh: 她大概会听从泽连斯基或乌克兰领导层的暗示。

sentences.en: OK, so to recap, Ukraine, these candidates are quite different.
sentences.zh: 好的，总而言之，在乌克兰问题上，这些候选人截然不同。

sentences.en: Israel, more complicated.
sentences.zh: 以色列问题则更加复杂。

sentences.en: Are there areas where they're similar?
sentences.zh: 有没有他们相似的领域？

sentences.en: There's not a lot of similarity between these two when it comes to foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 在外交政策方面，这两个人没有太多相似之处。

sentences.en: But there is one area of the world where they actually kind of start from a similar point of view.
sentences.zh: 但世界上确实有一个领域，他们的出发点其实有点相似。

sentences.en: And that's China.
sentences.zh: 那就是中国。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wenna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《连线》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天创作《拼写蜜蜂》和《字母框》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由你刚刚听过的那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games 从今天开始游玩。

sentences.en: So, Peter, tell me about the two candidates in China.
sentences.zh: 那么，彼得，跟我讲讲两位候选人在中国问题上的看法。

sentences.en: You said this is one area where they do actually overlap.
sentences.zh: 你说这是他们确实有交集的一个领域。

sentences.en: And maybe start with Trump here.
sentences.zh: 也许可以从特朗普开始讲起。

sentences.en: I remember him coming in in 2017 and saying he was really going to take China to task.
sentences.zh: 我记得他在2017年上任时说他真的要狠狠地惩治中国。

sentences.en: He was going to change things with China.
sentences.zh: 他要改变与中国的关系。

sentences.en: He did change things with China.
sentences.zh: 他确实改变了与中国的关系。

sentences.en: And I think he changed things in Washington with regard to China.
sentences.zh: 我认为他改变了华盛顿对中国的态度。

sentences.en: The old way of thinking about China and Washington had been if we bring them into the international community,
sentences.zh: 华盛顿过去看待中国的思维方式一直是，如果我们把他们带入国际社会，

sentences.en: if we make them a member of the WTO, if we make them part of our globalized system, they will moderate their behavior.
sentences.zh: 如果我们让他们成为世贸组织的成员，如果我们让他们成为我们全球化体系的一部分，他们就会温和化他们的行为。

sentences.en: They will not be as big an aggressive threat on the international stage and maybe even become more democratic at home.
sentences.zh: 他们在国际舞台上就不会构成那么大的侵略性威胁，甚至可能在内部变得更加民主。

sentences.en: Well, that theory failed.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那种理论破产了。

sentences.en: And in its place, Trump created a new bipartisan consensus, which is that China is, in fact, an adversary, not a friend.
sentences.zh: 取而代之的是，特朗普创造了一种新的两党共识，即中国实际上是一个对手，而不是朋友。

sentences.en: That, in fact, we are too dependent on China economically and that we ought to be more skeptical of their leadership and their motivations
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们在经济上过度依赖中国，我们应该对他们的领导层和动机保持更多怀疑，

sentences.en: and less assuming that we can make, you know, common cause with them.
sentences.zh: 而少一些认为我们可以与他们结为同盟的假设。

sentences.en: Now, how he approaches it is different than how the Democrats would approach it.
sentences.zh: 现在，他处理这个问题的方式与民主党人的处理方式不同。

sentences.en: He launched really a trade war with China with massive tariffs and constantly attacking their leadership.
sentences.zh: 他对中国发起了真正的贸易战，实施了巨额关税，并不断攻击他们的领导层。

sentences.en: But it was all very transactional.
sentences.zh: 但这一切都非常具有交易性质。

sentences.en: It was all for him about economics, about intellectual property and trade and supply chains.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，这一切都关乎经济、知识产权、贸易和供应链。

sentences.en: He didn't care at all about Taiwan and its perpetual conflict with China, which has always been at the heart of our relationship with Beijing.
sentences.zh: 他根本不在乎台湾及其与中国大陆的长期冲突，而这一直是我们的北京关系的核心。

sentences.en: He didn't care about advances in the South China Sea or China's bullying of the Philippines or other neighbors.
sentences.zh: 他不在乎南海的进展，也不在乎中国对菲律宾或其他邻国的欺凌。

sentences.en: In fact, there was a really telling anecdote when he was president and he was going to be talking with Xi Jinping, the Chinese president,
sentences.zh: 事实上，有一个非常说明问题的轶事：当他担任总统并准备与中国国家主席习近平交谈时，

sentences.en: and Nancy Pelosi, the Democratic speaker, who's been a long time China hawk.
sentences.zh: 长期以来的对华强硬派、民主党众议长南希·佩洛西。

sentences.en: Xi told him that he should raise the plight of the Uyghurs.
sentences.zh: 习近平告诉他，他应该提出维吾尔族人的困境。

sentences.en: Those are the Muslim minority who are kept in camps, in many cases, in China, very repressed.
sentences.zh: 那些被关押在营地里的穆斯林少数群体，在许多情况下在中国，受到了极大的压制。

sentences.en: Trump did raise it with Xi and then tells Pelosi that, oh, it's okay.
sentences.zh: 特朗普确实向习近平提出了这个问题，然后告诉佩洛西，哦，没关系。

sentences.en: Xi told me they like being in those camps.
sentences.zh: 习近平告诉我他们喜欢待在那些营地里。

sentences.en: They like being in those camps.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢待在那些营地里。

sentences.en: And Pelosi was astonished, right?
sentences.zh: 佩洛西感到震惊，对吧？

sentences.en: On what planet do people like being in camps?
sentences.zh: 在哪个星球上会有人喜欢待在营地里？

sentences.en: And yet that's the way Trump saw it.
sentences.zh: 然而特朗普就是这么看的。

sentences.en: Oh, okay, it's all fine.
sentences.zh: 哦，好吧，一切都很好。

sentences.en: What really he cared about was economics.
sentences.zh: 他真正关心的是经济。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: So, Peter, what about Harris?
sentences.zh: 那么，彼得，哈里斯呢？

sentences.en: I mean, presumably she does care about Uyghurs and democracy.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，大概她确实关心维吾尔人和民主。

sentences.en: Tell me about how Xi would approach China.
sentences.zh: 告诉我她会如何对待中国。

sentences.en: I think Harris would come at it from the more traditional, mainly bipartisan approach, which is less confrontational, less hostile in tone and positioning.
sentences.zh: 我认为哈里斯会从更传统、主要是两党共识的方法切入，这种方法在基调和立场上不那么具有对抗性，不那么充满敌意。

sentences.en: But, you know, Xi, like Biden, is not going to back down on the economic measures that Trump put in place.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，像拜登一样，她也不会在特朗普实施的经济措施上退缩。

sentences.en: I mean, one of the things that Biden did was to keep the tariffs on China that he had criticized as a candidate.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，拜登做的事情之一就是保留了他在竞选时曾批评过的对华关税。

sentences.en: So he decided it was too politically costly or whatever to take them off.
sentences.zh: 所以他决定取消关税的政治代价太大，无论如何。

sentences.en: But his approach, and I think hers would follow, has been more targeted since then.
sentences.zh: 但他的方法，我想她的方法也会效仿，从那以后变得更加具有针对性。

sentences.en: They have doubled down on the semiconductor industry in the United States so that we are making more of these computer chips that are central to everything in our economy,
sentences.zh: 他们加倍押注美国的半导体产业，这样我们就能生产更多对我们经济一切都至关重要的电脑芯片，

sentences.en: rather than relying quite so much on Taiwan in particular, but China as well.
sentences.zh: 而不是像以前那样过分依赖台湾，尤其是中国大陆。

sentences.en: And the sanctions that Biden has put in place on China have been more narrowly formulated, in his view, to get at the things we care about most,
sentences.zh: 在他看来，拜登对中国实施的制裁制定的更加狭隘，旨在针对我们最关心的事物，

sentences.en: not to actually break all ties with China.
sentences.zh: 而不是真正切断与中国的所有联系。

sentences.en: The phrase that his national security advisor, Jake Sullivan, uses is, we are de-risking, not decoupling.
sentences.zh: 他的国家安全顾问杰克·沙利文使用的短语是，我们正在去风险，而不是脱钩。

sentences.en: And what does that mean, Peter?
sentences.zh: 那是什么意思，彼得？

sentences.en: Well, we were trying to take away the risks of being too dependent on China, particularly when it comes to supply chains.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们试图消除过度依赖中国的风险，特别是在供应链方面。

sentences.en: Decoupling means we're completely cutting off.
sentences.zh: 脱钩意味着我们彻底切断联系。

sentences.en: We're no longer going to have this economic relationship.
sentences.zh: 我们将不再拥有这种经济关系。

sentences.en: And that's unrealistic as far as Biden is concerned.
sentences.zh: 就拜登而言，这是不切实际的。

sentences.en: I think that Harris shares that view.
sentences.zh: 我认为哈里斯持同样的观点。

sentences.en: So kind of a scalpel versus a hammer when it comes to trying to get tougher on China.
sentences.zh: 所以在试图对中国采取更强硬态度时，这有点像手术刀对阵铁锤。

sentences.en: Exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: But there's also the issue of Russia when it comes to China, right?
sentences.zh: 但在中国问题上，也存在俄罗斯的问题，对吧？

sentences.en: Our relationship with China has changed in the last three years since Trump left office because of China's support for Russia's invasion in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 自从特朗普卸任以来，由于中国对俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的支持，我们在过去三年中与中国的关系发生了变化。

sentences.en: And Russia and China have aligned themselves much more closely in the last few years.
sentences.zh: 在过去几年里，俄罗斯和中国结成了更紧密的同盟。

sentences.en: And that's a very different challenge.
sentences.zh: 这是一个截然不同的挑战。

sentences.en: And remind listeners, Peter, what exactly China is doing for Russia there.
sentences.zh: 请提醒听众，彼得，中国究竟在为俄罗斯做什么。

sentences.en: What's the importance of that relationship?
sentences.zh: 这种关系的重要性体现在哪里？

sentences.en: Well, China is propping Russia up economically right now, where the West has cut Russia off with sanctions and so forth,
sentences.zh: 嗯，在西方对俄罗斯实施制裁等措施、把俄罗斯孤立起来的当下，中国正在经济上支撑着俄罗斯，

sentences.en: where Western companies have fled Russia and taken their money with them.
sentences.zh: 西方公司纷纷逃离俄罗斯并带走了资金，

sentences.en: It has been China that has filled the gap.
sentences.zh: 正是中国填补了这个真空。

sentences.en: China is buying Russian energy.
sentences.zh: 中国正在购买俄罗斯的能源。

sentences.en: China is supporting Russia economically.
sentences.zh: 中国正在经济上支持俄罗斯。

sentences.en: And the worry is that China at some point will supply weapons to them.
sentences.zh: 人们担心的是，中国在某个时候会向他们提供武器。

sentences.en: And China has become Russia's best friend.
sentences.zh: 而且中国已经成了俄罗斯最好的朋友。

sentences.en: And, Peter, what would that mean for Trump if he won?
sentences.zh: 皮特，如果特朗普获胜，这意味着什么？

sentences.en: I mean, Trump, of course, as you're pointing out, so close to Putin, so admiring of Putin, and quite the opposite with China.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，正如你所指出的，特朗普当然与普京非常亲近，非常钦佩普京，对中国则完全相反。

sentences.en: This is an interesting not for him then.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，这倒是个有趣的不确定因素。

sentences.en: It really is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Ironically, of course, we'd have these three countries, in effect, led by strong leaders who see the world in similar terms and how that would play out.
sentences.zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，我们当然会有这三个国家，实际上由一些强硬领导人领导，他们以相似的眼光看待世界，而这将如何发展。

sentences.en: That's a really interesting question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常有趣的问题。

sentences.en: I don't know that we know the answer to that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我们是否知道答案。

sentences.en: So, Peter, I guess the thing that's really striking to me here is just how different Trump is from his party, how much he's changed in a way on Russia, on China,
sentences.zh: 所以，皮特，我觉得这里真正引人注目的是，特朗普与他的党派有多么不同，他在俄罗斯、中国问题上的立场在某种程度上发生了多大变化，

sentences.en: even some ways on Israel, while Harris, in many ways, is very much the product of her party.
sentences.zh: 甚至在某些方面对以色列的看法也是如此，而哈里斯在很多方面则是她所在党派的典型代表。

sentences.en: Is that the way this period in American foreign policy will be remembered?
sentences.zh: 美国外交政策的这段时期会被这样铭记吗？

sentences.en: Is that the key takeaway here?
sentences.zh: 这是这里最关键的收获吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it's a very good way to put it, that he is changing his party and she is a product of hers.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得这种说法很好，他在改变他的党派，而她是她党派的产物。

sentences.en: But it's really even not so much about ideology.
sentences.zh: 但这实际上甚至不是意识形态的问题。

sentences.en: It's not even really about Democrats and Republicans.
sentences.zh: 甚至也不是民主党人和共和党人的问题。

sentences.en: It's really about predictability and unpredictability.
sentences.zh: 这实际上关乎可预测性与不可预测性。

sentences.en: In other words, Harris represents a much more stable way of looking at the world.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，哈里斯代表了一种看待世界更加稳定的方式。

sentences.en: And other leaders have a much better sense of where she will come out of things.
sentences.zh: 其他领导人对她的立场会有更好的把握。

sentences.en: And he is volatile and he is mercurial.
sentences.zh: 而他是反复无常、变幻莫测的。

sentences.en: He threatens to leave NATO one minute and has to be talked into staying in the next.
sentences.zh: 他一会儿威胁要退出北约，一会儿又得被劝说留下来。

sentences.en: That difference is the main difference between them, right?
sentences.zh: 这种区别是他们两人之间最大的区别，对吧？

sentences.en: Predictability and unpredictability.
sentences.zh: 可预测性与不可预测性。

sentences.en: And is there any argument for unpredictability as a deterrent?
sentences.zh: 那么，把不可预测性作为一种威慑，这种说法成立吗？

sentences.en: Like, we don't quite know where this guy is going to come out on whatever crazy thing we're trying to do.
sentences.zh: 比如，对于我们要搞的任何疯狂事情，我们根本不知道这家伙会作何反应。

sentences.en: So we maybe shouldn't try to do it?
sentences.zh: 所以我们也许不该去尝试？

sentences.en: Well, that's certainly an argument here from Trump's side.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这当然是特朗普阵营的一套说辞。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: The madman theory, if you will, of foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 也就是外交政策中的疯子理论。

sentences.en: Now, Richard Nixon famously used this tactic.
sentences.zh: 理查德·尼克松曾以使用这种策略而闻名。

sentences.en: He told Kissinger to tell foreign leaders that he, Nixon, was kind of crazy.
sentences.zh: 他告诉基辛格，去向外国领导人透露他尼克松有点疯。

sentences.en: And therefore, they ought to do whatever Kissinger was asking because I have no idea if I can control the boss.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们最好顺从基辛格提出的任何要求，因为我根本不知道自己能不能控制住老板。

sentences.en: In some ways, Trump does the same thing.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，特朗普也在做同样的事情。

sentences.en: But with Nixon, it was a tactic.
sentences.zh: 但对尼克松来说，这只是一种策略。

sentences.en: With Trump, it's just who he is, right?
sentences.zh: 对特朗普来说，这就是他本人，对吧？

sentences.en: He is, in fact,
sentences.zh: 他实际上是

sentences.en: somebody who will decide on the spur of the moment to do something drastically different on foreign policy without a big process and a committee meeting and so forth.
sentences.zh: 那种会临时起意在外交政策上做出颠覆性举动的人，而不需要经过冗长的程序和委员会会议之类的流程。

sentences.en: So traditionally, of course, America has preferred to have predictable and stable relations with other countries.
sentences.zh: 因此，传统上，美国当然更愿意与别国保持可预测、稳定的关系。

sentences.en: But Trump is, again, as always, the outlier who challenges that thinking.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普依然如故，一如既往地成为了挑战这种思维的局外人。

sentences.en: On the other hand, though, just to play this out, if Harris were to win, you know,
sentences.zh: 另一方面，话又说回来，如果把这种假设推演下去，如果哈里斯获胜，你知道的，

sentences.en: then there's something to be said about the fact that four more years of the same or at least a very similar foreign policy to Biden might also be problematic.
sentences.zh: 那么有一种观点认为，如果继续保持现状四年，或者至少延续与拜登非常相似的外交政策，也可能会带来问题。

sentences.en: Considering that all of these wars that we find ourselves pretty closely related to and very difficult to find our way out of.
sentences.zh: 考虑到所有这些与我们息息相关且让我们极难抽身的战争。

sentences.en: Yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: Of course, the argument is that traditional foreign policy hasn't worked well enough, right?
sentences.zh: 当然，这种论调是传统的外交政策还不够奏效，对吧？

sentences.en: That we are in these terrible crises in Europe and the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 我们在欧洲和中东正陷入这些可怕的危机中。

sentences.en: And what has our diplomacy gotten us?
sentences.zh: 我们的外交到底给我们带来了什么？

sentences.en: Now, it's hard to argue a counterfactual.
sentences.zh: 现在，去争论一个反事实是很困难的。

sentences.en: Would it be worse if X than Y?
sentences.zh: 如果做了X而不是Y，情况会更糟吗？

sentences.en: But in a world where you have adversaries who have nuclear weapons, the argument from the Biden side is better to keep things from boiling over in a much worse way.
sentences.zh: 但在一个拥有核武器对手的世界里，拜登阵营的论点是，最好防止事情以更糟糕的方式失控。

sentences.en: Maybe, you know, a Trumpian unpredictability is a deterrent on some level,
sentences.zh: 也许吧，你知道，特朗普式的不可预测性在某种程度上是一种威慑，

sentences.en: but it's better from their point of view anyway to have predictability because outcomes could be a whole lot worse.
sentences.zh: 但从他们的角度来看，保持可预测性还是更好，因为结果可能会糟得多。

sentences.en: Peter, what do you think this unpredictability does to American power and America's place in the world?
sentences.zh: 皮特，你认为这种不可预测性对美国的权力和美国在世界上的地位有什么影响？

sentences.en: Well, it's a really good question because, in fact, it used to be that the United States was the reliable actor.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一个很好的问题，事实上，过去美国一直是那个可靠的行动者。

sentences.en: You pretty much knew where the United States was going to fall on major issues in the world.
sentences.zh: 你基本清楚美国在世界重大问题上会持什么立场。

sentences.en: And other countries responded accordingly.
sentences.zh: 其他国家也会做出相应的反应。

sentences.en: Didn't mean that everybody did what the United States wanted them to do by any stretch.
sentences.zh: 这绝不意味着每个人都按照美国希望的那样去做。

sentences.en: But that that predictability, that reliability was central to at least a broad sense of order in the world.
sentences.zh: 但这种可预测性、这种可靠性，至少是维持世界秩序感的核心。

sentences.en: What you hear now from foreign officials is we don't know whether you guys are going to be there or not.
sentences.zh: 你现在从外国官员那里听到的是，我们不知道你们这帮人到底还会不会在场。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They're like, OK, is Trump the aberration or is Biden the aberration?
sentences.zh: 他们会想，好吧，特朗普是个例外，还是拜登是个例外？

sentences.en: Which one stands for where America really plans to be from now on?
sentences.zh: 到底哪一个才代表美国从今往后真正的打算？

sentences.en: Would the real America please stand up?
sentences.zh: 真正的美国请起立好吗？

sentences.en: We'll know a lot more come November.
sentences.zh: 到了十一月，我们会了解得更多。

sentences.en: Peter, thank you.
sentences.zh: 皮特，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Sunday, Israel launched long-distance airstrikes in Yemen, targeting shipping and power supplies of the Houthis,
sentences.zh: 周日，以色列对也门发动了长途空袭，目标是胡塞武装的航运和电力供应设施。

sentences.en: another group backed by Iran that has attacked Israel over the past year.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装是另一个得到伊朗支持、在过去一年里袭击过以色列的组织。

sentences.en: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said the show of force against multiple enemies at once was part of a broader strategy to create a new balance of power in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡表示，针对多个敌人的这种集中武力展示，是在中东建立新力量平衡的更广泛战略的一部分。

sentences.en: A spokesman for the Biden administration reiterated that the White House wants a diplomatic solution rather than an all-out war.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府的一名发言人重申，白宫想要的是外交解决，而不是全面战争。

sentences.en: And very serious situation in the South, the catastrophic aftermath of Hurricane Helene.
sentences.zh: 南部发生了一场非常严重的局势，那是飓风“海伦妮”造成的灾难性后果。

sentences.en: Millions of people are still without power.
sentences.zh: 数百万人的电力供应仍然中断。

sentences.en: Whole communities have been flattened.
sentences.zh: 整个社区被夷为平地。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, search and rescue efforts started in the South as more than six states reeled from the aftermath of Hurricane Helene.
sentences.zh: 周末期间，随着六个以上的州从飓风“海伦妮”的余波中缓过神来，南部的搜救工作已经展开。

sentences.en: Conditions are now safe enough in multiple states for officials to start surveying the damage.
sentences.zh: 目前多个州的情况已经足够安全，官员们可以开始勘查灾情了。

sentences.en: And what they are seeing in terms of Helene's wrath is horrifying.
sentences.zh: 他们所看到的“海伦妮”肆虐后的景象令人震惊。

sentences.en: So many communities in the Carolina mountains are now essentially cut off by road.
sentences.zh: 卡罗莱纳山区的好多社区现在基本上被公路隔绝了。

sentences.en: There are much-needed supplies that are being flown in in the same time.
sentences.zh: 急需的物资与此同时正通过飞机运送进去。

sentences.en: The storm, which made landfall along Florida's Big Bend region, carried strong winds and heavy rain far inland,
sentences.zh: 这场在佛罗里达州大本德地区登陆的风暴，携带着强风和暴雨深入内陆，

sentences.en: wreaking havoc in mostly rural areas in Tennessee, Georgia, South and North Carolina, and Virginia.
sentences.zh: 在田纳西州、佐治亚州、南卡罗来纳州、北卡罗来纳州和弗吉尼亚州的偏远乡村地区造成了严重破坏。

sentences.en: I don't think anyone was prepared for it.
sentences.zh: 我不认为有人对此做好了准备。

sentences.en: I don't think anyone thought it would be this bad.
sentences.zh: 我不认为有人会想到情况会这么糟。

sentences.en: There's probably 50 trees blocking my neighbor from coming out.
sentences.zh: 可能有50棵树挡住了我邻居出门的路。

sentences.en: I started helping them yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天开始帮他们。

sentences.en: The neighbors at the other end of the road, we got us out, but the other neighbors are trapped.
sentences.zh: 路尽头的邻居，我们设法让他们出来了，但其他邻居被困住了。

sentences.en: As of Sunday afternoon, the death toll from the storm totaled more than 90 people.
sentences.zh: 截至周日下午，风暴造成的死亡人数已超过90人。

sentences.en: But officials said to expect that number to rise as they reached residents who were stranded at their homes or were still unaccounted for.
sentences.zh: 但官员们表示，随着他们联系到被困家中或仍然失联的居民，这一数字预计还会上升。

sentences.zh: 这就是《今日秀》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔韦尔尼西。

sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个受到严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了－批自诩为改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱、有时甚至令人兴奋的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《都市》最新一期节目中，我和萨拉·科尼格将带您了解那些试图维持影响力却最终失去控制的人们的故事。
